remarks: A16ZSR006 yielded no new accepted rows after dedupe; the known Product Hunt, YouTube, Instagram, and Reddit items were already in the protected A16Z evidence file or prior hunt outputs.
Reddit produced plausible AgentPhone and Gojiberry AI leads, but Reddit blocked metric verification from this network.
GitHub API rate limiting prevented a full refresh of every official account; accepted GitHub rows are limited to repos verified before rate limit.
